crm_activities_lead_or_client_present.name: crm_activities_lead_or_client_present
crm_activities_lead_or_client_present.value: "crm_activities"."lead_id" IS NOT NULL OR "crm_activities"."client_id" IS NOT NULL

agent_approvals_exactly_one_target.name: agent_approvals_exactly_one_target
agent_approvals_exactly_one_target.value: ("agent_approvals"."execution_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_approvals"."plan_item_id" IS NULL) OR ("agent_approvals"."execution_id" IS NULL AND "agent_approvals"."plan_item_id" IS NOT NULL)

agent_responsibilities_escalation_target.name: agent_responsibilities_escalation_target_matches_policy
agent_responsibilities_escalation_target.value:
(
        ("agent_responsibilities"."escalation_policy" = 'none') OR
        ("agent_responsibilities"."escalation_policy" = 'agent' AND "agent_responsibilities"."escalation_target_agent_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("agent_responsibilities"."escalation_policy" = 'human' AND "agent_responsibilities"."escalation_target_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("agent_responsibilities"."escalation_policy" = 'agent_then_human' AND "agent_responsibilities"."escalation_target_agent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_responsibilities"."escalation_target_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )
